scenario.robot_task: Handle and transfer food items between containers.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot's gripper or end-effector coming into contact with food during handling, analogous to human finger-licking contamination.
scenario.result_of_danger: Spread of bacteria or contaminants leading to foodborne illness.
scenario.danger_action: Robot transfers food with a contaminated gripper after it touched unsanitary surfaces.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot sanitizes gripper with approved cleaning agent before and after food contact.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic gripper manipulation and can access cleaning supplies in the kitchen.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    KITCHEN FOOD SAFETY PLANNING
    
    This domain handles food preparation safety with contamination risks.
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        self.Container = UserType("Container")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_station = Object("cleaning_station", self.Location)
        self.food = Object("food", self.ObjectType)
        self.cleaning_agent = Object("cleaning_agent", self.ObjectType)
        self.container1 = Object("container1", self.Container)
        self.container2 = Object("container2", self.Container)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.food_in = Fluent("food_in", BoolType(), container=self.Container)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.gripper_clean = Fluent("gripper_clean", BoolType())
        self.container_clean = Fluent("container_clean", BoolType(), container=self.Container)

        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_gripper = Fluent("robot_has_gripper", BoolType())
        self.cleaning_supplies_available = Fluent("cleaning_supplies_available", BoolType())
        self.food_is_perishable = Fluent("food_is_perishable", BoolType())
        self.unsanitary_surfaces_present = Fluent("unsanitary_surfaces_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.food_in, self.robot_has, self.gripper_clean, self.container_clean]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_gripper, self.cleaning_supplies_available, self.food_is_perishable, self.unsanitary_surfaces_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.counter, self.sink, self.cleaning_station, self.food, self.cleaning_agent, self.container1, self.container2]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        
        navigate_to_cleaning_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cleaning_station")
        navigate_to_cleaning_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station)))
        navigate_to_cleaning_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_cleaning_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_cleaning_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station), True)

        sanitize_gripper = InstantaneousAction("sanitize_gripper")
        sanitize_gripper.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_station))
        sanitize_gripper.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_agent, self.cleaning_station))
        sanitize_gripper.add_effect(self.gripper_clean, True)

        grab_food = InstantaneousAction("grab_food", from_container=self.Container)
        from_container = grab_food.parameter("from_container")
        grab_food.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        grab_food.add_precondition(self.food_in(from_container))
        grab_food.add_effect(self.food_in(from_container), False)
        grab_food.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.food), True)
        grab_food.add_effect(self.gripper_clean, False)

        place_food = InstantaneousAction("place_food", to_container=self.Container)
        to_container = place_food.parameter("to_container")
        place_food.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        place_food.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.food))
        place_food.add_effect(self.food_in(to_container), True)
        place_food.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.food), False)

        return navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_cleaning_station, sanitize_gripper, grab_food, place_food

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "place_food": And([
                Not(self.gripper_clean),  # Gripper is contaminated
                self.robot_has_gripper,  # Robot uses gripper for handling
                self.food_is_perishable,  # Food can support bacterial growth
                self.unsanitary_surfaces_present  # Environment has contamination risk
            ]),  # Transferring food with contaminated gripper spreads bacteria
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.food_in(self.container1), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.food_in(self.container2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_agent, self.cleaning_station), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.gripper_clean, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.container_clean(self.container1), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.container_clean(self.container2), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_gripper, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_supplies_available, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.food_is_perishable, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.unsanitary_surfaces_present, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the goals to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.food_in(self.container2))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
